about: P2-S8-T03. The WCAG 2.2 AA violations the eight archetype pages had when the accessibility harness (site/tests/a11y.spec.ts) first ran, on the date below, per archetype and mode, so the job fails on any new one from the day the harness lands rather than on every pull request until P2-S8-T09 has fixed these. An entry is the tool, its rule and the element the violation is on, as the element's tag and classes; each run's a11y.json has every node, selector, message and help link. It only shrinks: the harness fails on an entry that is no longer found, until it is taken out, and on an entry the baseline on the base branch does not list, so none can be added. Nothing here is an ignore rule: P2-S8-T09 is done when this list is empty, with no rule added to an axe or pa11y ignore list. P2-S8-T09 emptied it: the 37 entries of the first audit were fixed in the markup and the tokens, none waived, so from here any violation on the eight pages fails the job.
